notes.title: End of Classic Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! First of all, let me apologize for the lack of support and feedback. We will be the first to admit that we have not held our side of the bargain, we have not hosted Mystica as reliably as you all deserve and for that we are deeply sorry. We don't intend on letting the project and all the hard work go to waste! To (hopefully) start to make it up to all you amazing people we have updated the Steam version to now include a copy of the server program. There is a new launcher that will offer to start your own server as well as add custom server links to that you can host a copy of the game if you so desire and players can save your server’s URL/IP address. That way, at least for the time being, the game can live on through you guys. However, with this change your accounts will have been lost and our server shut down. We are sorry to everyone and we are thankful that you have stuck with us while we struggled to keep everything up.

Here are a couple of important controls as you look to start up your own server:
After you sign into your server, you can right-click your name and set yourself as an admin
After you have set yourself as an admin, inside the game window you can hit the [INS] key to access all of the server tools
You can find more information on the game engine at [url=https://www.eclipseorigins.com/]https://www.eclipseorigins.com/[/url]

All of that said, I don’t want you all to think we are going the way of disco quite yet. Bread Vision is being rebooted for the new decade! We are excited to start working on new projects and updates for you guys. One of the projects currently on our table is Mystica 2.0! We are completely rebuilding and redesigning Mystica with a modern engine, design, and networking techniques. We want Mystica to be a game that is not only a fun, chill, and nostalgic experience; but be a game with modern conveniences, expandability, features, and above all stability! I cannot give any hard and fast dates on this new version, only that it is very much in the works and we hope to be sharing it soon.

We are getting ready to launch the new Bread Vision website as we start ourselves back up. We are going to work to get back in your good graces. I know you have heard this a lot from us… Please give us just a little more time to get ourselves in order and to get moving again. There will be more news coming down the pipe soon so please be on the lookout.

notes.title: Back in Debug Mode
notes.notes: Over the last two months we've been seeing the server crash from time to time. It's for this reason that the server is going into debug mode again. Nothing in game will change. This just means that when the server crashes I'll be able to know what code caused it and I can fix it on the spot. If you know of a game breaking bug please email us about it so we can get it all patched up. :)

notes.title: Some of what has come and is coming
notes.notes:
We don't release patch notes nearly enough. :/

1. Heavy work on rebalancing all classes
 - Changed the starting statis for all three classes *this is a big one and you probably want to have the fairy reset your stats to get some extra points*
 - reduced the price of mana potions
 - changed mana cost and damage of the shock spell
*this helped alot of beginer mages and fighters, not sure of the effects on higher levels yet*

 2. New steeper level curve
 - we felt people were leveling way too fast so we have increased the xp needed at higher levels, the begining core level were not as effected

 3. Currently working on fixing the login server, hoping my repair will work but you will need a new client update to see the fix

 4. Currently working to fix the ongoing damage property of certian spells

 5. Currenty working to add more monsters and areas

 6. Currently working on adding core of the lore and backstory (hoping a main story line/quest will follow soon afterwords)

 7. Trying to smooth the look of all of the sprites

Thats everything that I know anyway, hope do release more of these.

notes.title: Back to a fast server!
notes.notes:
With the new version of Mystica we're back to our old faster server.
Cox actually got around to moving our internet so now we are totally moved in and will have more time to work on games! 
Along with the new server settings this version of Mystica has a few game breaking bug fixes added so the game should run generally smoother.

Thanks for playing guys and I hope you all enjoy the new items and city on BlobDragon Island. I'll be adding more dungeons soon, and Evan is working on the lore.

notes.title: Mystica: The Ninth Society Development guidelines
notes.notes:
Hey guys I wanted to show you guys what we'll be working on for the next few months. As time goes on more will be added to this document but for now this is pretty much it. Keep in mind that this doesn't show everything that I hope to add to the game, only what is guaranteed to be added to the game.


Mystica: The Ninth Society 
Development guidelines 3/21/2016


March

Finish BlobDragon Island’s city.
-	10 maps
-	6 monsters
-	~15 events
-	2 secrets

Items and Spells
-	10 items
-	5 spells
-	5 mage items
-	5 fighter items

Other Stuff
-	Fix undisclosed bug 1


April

Books
-	Find artist for books
-	Start writing first in-game book

Other Stuff
-	Show other player’s HP bar when they’re less than max
-	Button/spell to target closest monster
-	Add monsters, maps, items, spells and more as needed
-	Fix undisclosed bug 2


May

Books
-	Release first set of book items

Other Stuff
-	Add monsters, maps, items, spells and more as needed
